lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army and maintain economy and production. Consider adding more Siege Tanks or transitioning to air if the opponent goes for Colossus or air units.
lessons.mistake: Committing to a single attack without sufficient army strength, risking a counterattack while the opponent is also building up.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech units, such as Colossus or air units.
lessons.title: Avoid overcommitting to a single attack
lessons.when: Midgame with a ground-oriented army, heavy production and technology, and moderate defense.
lessons.why: Siege Tanks provide strong defensive and offensive capabilities against ground armies. Maintaining a heavy economy allows you to tech switch if needed.

lessons.correction: Increase your air presence and strengthen your air army. Continue developing your economy and technology to support the transition.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting ground defense while focusing on air, as the opponent could still push with a strong ground army.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's anti-air capabilities or if they transition to air themselves.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting ground defense during air transition
lessons.when: Midgame with a ground-oriented army transitioning to air, with moderate air presence and Banshees.
lessons.why: Transitioning to air can give you an advantage if the opponent is heavily ground-based. Banshees can harass and provide mobility.
